headline: Ferguson's double sends Roma top
standfirst: Two headers in twenty minutes — the third different Irish name on the scoresheet in Italy this month.
body:
Evan Ferguson needed twenty minutes to settle a game that had looked like drifting.

The first came from a left-hand channel Roma had been working all half, the second from almost the identical spot eleven minutes later. Both headers, both from crosses the Lazio full-back never got near.

It takes his tally to three in four league games since the move, and makes him the third different Irish player to score in Serie A this month.

He came off to a standing ovation with twelve minutes left and the game long gone.
author: Footballers Staff

headline: Dara Fitzgerald's senior debut, straight off the bench
standfirst: The 18-year-old came on at Turner's Cross to a standing ovation in his first pro appearance.
body:
Turner's Cross has seen plenty of debuts. Not many get eighteen minutes and a standing ovation.

Dara Fitzgerald came on with the game gone, but the reception told you what the ground thinks of him. He has come through every underage level from U15 up.

Cork City have been careful with him. On this evidence they won't be able to be for much longer.
author: Footballers Staff

headline: Josh Cullen reaches 250 club appearances
standfirst: Marked with a clean sheet and the armband at Turf Moor.
body:
Two hundred and fifty games is a career in itself.

Cullen got there in the least dramatic way possible — ninety minutes at the base of midfield, 94% of his passes finding a teammate, and a clean sheet at the end of it.

He wore the armband for the occasion.
author: Footballers Staff
